assessment_rules: The final grade is 0.5 x Project (P) + 0.5 x Exam (E), with a minimum grade of 8.0 for both components. The project grade is multiplied by a discussion grade (0 to 1). For the resit period, the final grade is 0.5 x P + 0.5 x (max(E.T,R.T)+max(E.P,R.P)), where .T and .P are the theoretical and practical parts of the exams, and both components have a minimum grade of 8.0. For special period, students who do not approve the project in the normal period can do an individual project or in groups of 2 students plus the exam.
